symbols.name: coordinate label set
symbols.meaning: The finite set of coordinate labels, one for each coordinate of the vectors.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal I$ be the finite set of coordinate labels, one for each coordinate of the vectors.

symbols.name: coordinate label
symbols.meaning: A label naming one coordinate of the vectors, an element of the set of labels.
symbols.quote: Each label $\iota\in\mathcal I$ names one coordinate, and $x_\iota$ is the value of a vector $x$ at that coordinate.

symbols.name: array space
symbols.meaning: The vector space of arrays indexed by the labels, with entries in F.
symbols.quote: Write $F^{\mathcal I}$ for the vector space of arrays $x=(x_\iota)_{\iota\in\mathcal I}$ with entries $x_\iota\in F$.

symbols.name: scalar family
symbols.meaning: A family of scalars, one for each label, that sets the scaling.
symbols.quote: Given a family of scalars $\upsilon=(\upsilon_\iota)_{\iota\in\mathcal I}$ with each $\upsilon_\iota\in F$, the diagonal scaling $\Delta_\upsilon$ is the map

symbols.name: diagonal scaling
symbols.meaning: The map sending each array to the array whose $\iota$-th entry is $\upsilon_\iota$ times its $\iota$-th entry.
symbols.quote: Given a family of scalars $\upsilon=(\upsilon_\iota)_{\iota\in\mathcal I}$ with each $\upsilon_\iota\in F$, the diagonal scaling $\Delta_\upsilon$ is the map

symbols.name: second scalar family
symbols.meaning: A second family of scalars, one for each label, used to compose two scalings.
symbols.quote: Second, for a second family $\upsilon'=(\upsilon'_\iota)_{\iota\in\mathcal I}$ of scalars, $\Delta_\upsilon\Delta_{\upsilon'}=\Delta_{\upsilon\upsilon'}$, where $(\upsilon\upsilon')_\iota=\upsilon_\iota\upsilon'_\iota$.

symbols.name: one-bit count
symbols.meaning: The number of selected bits of the address $\alpha$ that equal $1$.
symbols.quote: For an address $\alpha$, let $\operatorname{ones}(\alpha)$ be the number of selected bits of $\alpha$ equal to $1$.

relations.quote: A diagonal scaling is built from the linear maps of [Linear algebra basics](linear-algebra-basics.md).
